query: In a regional electricity market, an electric utility is required to make purchasing and scheduling decisions for generation resources for a future planning period. The company has a choice of three main types of generation: coal, gas and renewables. Since contracts with suppliers are usually purchased on a 'lot' basis, where each lot corresponds to a fixed amount of generation and orders must be placed in whole lots, as described in energy.csv, the company needs to meet its total demand (200) and minimize costs.

#### Decision Variables

For each option $k$ (using the "option" identifier from the table above):

$$
x_k \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}
$$

where $x_k$ is the number of lots purchased for generation option $k$.

#### Objective Function

Minimize total cost:

$$
\min \sum_{k} \text{cost\_per\_lot}_k \cdot x_k
$$

#### Constraint

Meet or exceed total demand (200 units):

$$
\sum_{k} \text{gen\_per\_lot}_k \cdot x_k \geq 200
$$

#### Variable Domains

$$
x_k \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0} \quad \forall k
$$

#### Complete Model

$$
\begin{align*}
\min \quad & \sum_{k} \text{cost\_per\_lot}_k \cdot x_k \\
\text{s.t.} \quad & \sum_{k} \text{gen\_per\_lot}_k \cdot x_k \geq 200 \\
& x_k \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0} \quad \forall k
\end{align*}
$$

where $k$ runs over all options in the source order of energy.csv, with coefficients as listed above.
